## Jira
[CB-<number>](https://ansamcd.atlassian.net/browse/CB-<number>)

## Change
Describe the problem, implementation and module boundaries affected.

## Validation
List commands actually executed and results. Identify NO-SOURCE tasks, skipped checks and blockers.

## Review
- [ ] Scope matches one Jira ticket and its dependencies
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior and practical regression cases
- [ ] Public contracts and architectural decisions documented
- [ ] Concurrency, permissions and resource ownership reviewed where relevant
- [ ] Diff contains no secrets, signing material or captured screen data
- [ ] Ready for human review; no merge or next ticket without review
